# ORGANIC INDIA — OI BUILD & DESIGN

> ORGANIC INDIA (OI BUILD & DESIGN) is an interior design and turnkey solutions firm in Ramnagariya Road, Jagatpura, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302017, India. It designs and executes residential, commercial and industrial projects — homes, apartments (2 BHK / 3 BHK), villas, offices, shops, showrooms, clinics and factories.

## Key facts
- Business name: ORGANIC INDIA (supporting line: OI BUILD & DESIGN). Category: Interior Designers & Decorators.
- Address: Plot No. 1-2, Shop No. 5, Ganesh Nagar, Near Mahima Panorama Chouraha, Next to Car King Service Centre, Ramnagariya Road, Jagatpura, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302017, India.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 93159 01235
- Email: interiors0141@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.organicindiainteriors.com/
- Service areas: Jagatpura, Ramnagaria, Gyan Vihar, Malviya Nagar, Durgapura, Pratap Nagar, Sanganer, Mansarovar and wider Jaipur.
- Process: Consultation → Concept → 2D planning → 3D design → Material selection → Execution → Handover.
- Pricing: quoted per project after consultation and site assessment; no fixed price list is published.

## Services
- [Residential interior design](https://www.organicindiainteriors.com/residential-interior-design.html): homes, apartments, 2 BHK, 3 BHK and villas.
- [Commercial & office interiors](https://www.organicindiainteriors.com/commercial-office-interiors.html): offices, shops, showrooms, studios, clinics.
- [Modular kitchen & wardrobes](https://www.organicindiainteriors.com/modular-kitchen-wardrobe.html)

## Track record (selected executed projects)
- Industrial: BLS Ecotech (Neemrana, Bhiwadi, Abu Dhabi), Indag Rubber (Nalagarh, Bhiwadi), Kumar Food / Shakti Bhog Foods (Sonepat), FCC Clutch India — Honda subsidiary (Bhiwadi, Manesar), Trelleborg Vibracoustic (Mohali), Good Year India (Ballabhgarh), Color N Style, Shree Jagdamba Knits, Skylark Dyeing (Greater Noida), Case Component (Gurgaon), Balkrishna Industries (Bhiwadi).
- Institutional / government: MTNL telephone exchange (New Delhi), ONGC LGFS building (Karaikal), NSIC building (Okhla), NAFED, MARKFED Punjab, Jaquar Foundation Swachh Mission.
- Other: temples, group housing (incl. Tehran, Iran), clubs (New Friends Club, New Delhi), cultural centres (Virsa Vihar, Amritsar), hotels, hospitals.
